input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: buildbot-sheathing milestone 78: an augmented (e, beta) filter that learns the free-air reading's gravity-model error

errors.what: First dry run of run.py was very slow: pee_sequence looped over every press of every sheet for every candidate tare count, and the q(0,P) table was rebuilt on each simulate call
errors.fix: closed-form in-sheet variance and a cached q table; same numbers, about 10x faster

errors.what: The container restarted mid-run (12 of 18 rows done) and killed the background experiment
errors.fix: run.py gained an optional M78_CACHE directory that keeps finished rows, so the rerun resumed; one ~25 min loss

integrity_issues: NAIVE-CAL 'uncalibratable' cells are uncalibratable only above the inherited 1e-5 bisection floor; a side check (not in results.txt) found the G1 LAYOUT 0.1 row meets 1% at 1e-7 by taring every sheet. Disclosed in LOG, README, paper, post rather than reported as 'cannot be recalibrated'.
H326 was refuted on ties (7 of 11 rows tie for every policy), a framing flaw in the registered hypothesis; reported as refuted, not reinterpreted.

doc_friction.issue: Long experiments are told to run in the background, but nothing warns that a container restart kills them; a per-row result cache (as m78's M78_CACHE) would be a good default for multi-minute runs.
Fails on main with 2 dead links in portfolio/monetization/hardware-bets.md, unrelated to research PRs; had to stash to confirm they were pre-existing.

deviations.why: North star says for-profit work first, but the router's weighted draw sent this run to the research track; followed the router, as prompt.md routes runs.

notes: Hypotheses H320-H326 registered and pushed before the full run. Local checks: research/_homepage/build.py ok; paper/check_numbers.py 521/521; check_posts ok; programme_check ok; project tests 258 passed, 8 skipped. augfilter.simulate reproduces milestone 77's BALANCE draw for draw at sb = 0 (test).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: design and code a 2-state filter + schedule, tests, a 50 min sweep, write-up and paper paragraph: about two working days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
